name: leidus
what: the fruit in the material card's photograph (Ivar Leidus, 'Lychee fruits and seed', Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0): cultivar unknown, days old, rounded plates. Lengths in mm. Tags as materials/lychee/material.json.

D_mm.source: the photograph has no scale: a typical size (Brewster 36.1 mm across [M, nacif2001]; 13.36-56.04 g over 120 accessions [M, yuan2023]); the card's scale follows it, so its px/mm is uncertain by about 15 %

L_over_D.source: the limb's ellipse in the photo, 2513 x 2069 px (materials/lychee/measure_ref.py), the fruit lying on its side, long axis across

shoulder.source: slightly broader at the stem, by eye on the photo

spacing_over_D.source: the card's photo (leidus2021), plates counted face-on at the fruit's centre on a 100 px grid: about 220 px for a fruit 2280 px across (mean of the limb ellipse's axes); taken over to Guiwei [A]

height_over_D.source: the limb's peaks over its median-filtered outline: median prominence 41 px for a fruit 2280 px across (p25-p75 24-60 px, max 73)

sharpness_q.source: rounded plates (q < 1: convex flanks), by eye on the photo's face-on plates

jitter.source: plate centres: a Fibonacci lattice moved by up to this many spacings

thickness_mm.source: at the grooves; 0.74-3.13 over 120 accessions [M, yuan2023]; Guiwei's is thin and brittle [I, popular]

layer_gap_mm.source: between the two layers: an artefact of the renderers' one medium per closed surface (material.json model)

pericarp_aril_mm.source: the endocarp often separates from the aril (nacif2001)

aril_seed_mm.source: the aril grows from the funicle and wraps the seed (nacif2001; PCP 2015); not attached over the seed's surface

length_mm.source: the photo's seed is 0.82 of the fruit's mean diameter long, 0.37 wide, in front of the fruit (so drawn about 10 % larger) [M, by eye on the 1500 px preview]: 0.75 x 30 mm

thickness_mm.source: a little flatter than wide, as lychee seeds are

mesh.source: the card frames 84 mm across: 0.1 mm is a quarter of a 1080p pixel
